and to accept the instruction of doctrine,
so as to give discernment to little ones,
and the intelligent shall possess governments.
He shall turn his soul to a parable and to its interpretation,
to the words of the wise and their enigmas.
The fear of the Lord is the beginning of wisdom.
The foolish despise wisdom as well as doctrine.
to the discipline of your father,
et ne dimittas legem matris tuæ:
and forsake not the law of your mother,
so that grace may be added to your head
and a collar to your neck.
If they should say: “Come with us.
We will lie in wait for blood.
We will lay traps against the innocent, without cause.
Let us swallow him alive, like Hell,
et integrum quasi descendentem in lacum;
and whole, like one descending into the pit.
We will discover every precious substance.
We will fill our houses with spoils.
One purse will be for us all.”
prohibe pedem tuum a semitis eorum:
Preclude your feet from their paths.
pedes enim illorum ad malum currunt,
For their feet rush to evil,
and they hurry to shed blood.
Frustra autem jacitur rete ante oculos pennatorum.
But a net is thrown in vain before the eyes of those who have wings.
Ipsi quoque contra sanguinem suum insidiantur,
Likewise, they lie in ambush against their own blood,
et moliuntur fraudes contra animas suas.
and they undertake deceits against their own souls.
the ways of all those who are greedy seize the souls of those who possess.
she bestows her voice in the streets.
She cries out at the head of crowds;
in foribus portarum urbis profert verba sua,
at the entrance of the gates of the city, she offers her words,
how long will you choose to be childish,
et stulti ea quæ sibi sunt noxia cupient,
and how long will the foolish desire what is harmful to themselves,
and how long will the imprudent hate knowledge?
Lo, I will offer my spirit to you,
and I will reveal my words to you.
and there was no one who watched.
You have despised all my counsels,
and you have neglected my rebukes.
Ego quoque in interitu vestro ridebo,
Similarly, I will ridicule you at your demise,
et subsannabo cum vobis id quod timebatis advenerit.
and I will mock you, when that which you feared shall overcome you.
When sudden calamity rushes upon you,
and your demise advances like a tempest,
quando venerit super vos tribulatio et angustia:
when tribulation and anguish overcome you,
then they will call to me,
they will arise in the morning,
For they held hatred for discipline,
and they would not accept the fear of the Lord;
they would not consent to my counsel,
but they detracted from all of my corrections.
Therefore, they shall eat the fruit of their way,
and they shall have their fill of their own counsels.
The loathing of the little ones shall destroy them,
and the prosperity of the foolish shall perish them.
Qui autem me audierit, absque terrore requiescet,
But whoever will listen to me shall rest without terror,
et abundantia perfruetur, timore malorum sublato.
and shall have full enjoyment of abundance, without fear of evils.”
